propositions: Usage rows for Anthropic and OpenAI models fail to price when model_ref is passed as provider-qualified string (e.g. 'anthropic:claude-opus-4-8') to genai_prices.calc_price, raising LookupError that is silently caught and converted to unpriced
Bedrock usage rows asymmetrically price successfully with provider prefix, creating a false appearance that Bedrock is the only measurable arm in provider cost comparisons

Provider-aware id translation must be decided by registry membership rather than naive prefix stripping or split(':'), because versioned AWS ids like 'anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0' would be incorrectly truncated to '0'
LookupError catch policy must remain intact to ensure pricing never breaks summarize, but unpriced models must be distinguishable from mis-formatted ids in output
Regression introduced by provider-seam work epic where ran_model switched from bare model id to provider-qualified form before being recorded to usage_log
